column22: This category encompasses providing any spam information or content that directs users to communicate outside the platform, which violates the platform Terms and Conditions. This includes but is not limited to promoting off-platform transactions, soliciting business partnerships or collaborations through unauthorized channels, and any attempts to circumvent platform communication systems.
This category may contain suspected instances of repetitive offensive language appearing in the content.
This category covers buyer users who alert there may be a potential risk of information leakage on the platform.
This category may contain instances of suspected unauthorized image use.

This category encompasses moderation implemented on products where sellers exhibit a likelihood of Intellectual Property Right infringement, based on factors such as historical infringement records and abnormal transaction behavior.

This category encompasses content involving or potentially involving minors, regardless of context or nature. It includes age-ambiguous individuals, non-sexualized images of minors, and content where minors appear incidentally rather than as the primary focus. Therefore, this category captures a broad range of minor-related content for review purposes.
This category encompasses content that violates laws and regulations of People's republic of China, which related to national security and defamation.
This category encompasses moderation implemented when users exhibit a moderate likelihood of fraud, based on factors such as historical infringement records and abnormal transaction behavior.
This category encompasses products misplaced in the platform's product categories due to trader actions or errors in accordance with platform T&Cs.
